entities.name: Ramón Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Jaime Martínez is a Dominican-American former pitcher in Major League Baseball. He won 135 games over a 13-year career, mostly with the Los Angeles Dodgers. He is the older brother of Hall of Fame pitcher Pedro Martínez, and is currently a senior advisor in Latin America for the Baltimore Orioles.
